title: Level
description: One level. The folder name is the level id. A path like backgrounds/room.webp is inside this level. A path starting with / is from content/, for shared files: /shared/backgrounds/room.webp.

name.description: Label shown in tools. Defaults to the folder name.

startScene.description: Scene id opened when the level starts. Defaults to the first scene.

ambience.description: Looping background sound for the whole level. A scene can replace it with its own.

scenes.description: Scenes keyed by id. The id is used by startScene and by other files.

name.description: Label shown in tools. Defaults to the scene id.

fit.description: cover fills the screen and crops the edges. contain shows the whole image with bars around it.

background.description: Background image. Shared art uses /shared/backgrounds/room.webp. An animated WebP loops. Leave it out for a dark placeholder.

dialogue.description: Dialogue id from content/dialogues, played when the scene opens, before onEnter.

ambience.description: Replaces the level ambience while this scene is open.

onEnter.description: Actions run when the scene opens, after dialogue.

triggers.description: Invisible boxes, in pixels of the background. A click runs their actions. The debug panel can draw them.

id.description: Name used in tools and error messages.

x.description: Center of the rectangle, in pixels of the background.

y.description: Center of the rectangle, in pixels of the background.

actions.description: Run in order on click. sound does not wait. dialogue waits. go opens a scene and stops the list.

go.description: Scene id in this same level.

shake.description: true uses the default shake. An object can set intensity (pixels) and duration (milliseconds).

image.description: Character image. Shared art uses /shared/characters/hana.webp. An animated WebP loops.

x.description: Center of the character, in pixels of the background image.

y.description: Center of the character, in pixels of the background image.

scale.description: Relative to the background. 1 keeps the image's own pixel size.
